name: vlf-slow-gain-wide-bound-preservation
purpose: Fixed complete-message preservation cohort for slow gain models when the declared receiver allowance exceeds the actual variation. Physical pi*sin(2*pi*t/7200) phase, weak wanted/noise controls and strong wrong-key control retain the original inputs; only the atmospheric receiver allowance is widened to 0.002 Hz. Three deterministic episodes, with no population, outage-duration or CPU-capacity claim; communication and negative-control failures remain separate from execution completion.
